decision_rationale: Raygun is explicitly described as an auto-encoder with decoder-side generation and generative sampling. It is also pretrained on ~80,000 UniRef50 proteins and used for broad sequence modification tasks.
evidence_snippet: "auto-encoder"; "support generative sampling"; "trained on around 80,000 proteins from UniRef50"; "single-shot generation"

decision_rationale: Unify is presented as a transfer learning framework for universal cell embeddings and cross-species prediction, not a generative architecture. The evidence supports broad transferable representations but not generation.
evidence_snippet: "learns universal cell embeddings"; "transfer learning methodology"; "combining RNA expression with embeddings"; "prediction of perturbation responses across species"

decision_rationale: scMIR is a pretrained vision-language foundation model with strong transferable representations, but the provided sections only show self-supervised image reconstruction and text-guided alignment. They do not clearly establish a genuinely generative text-bio mechanism.
evidence_snippet: "self-supervised image reconstruction with text-guided cross-modal alignment"; "pretrained on 207,957 image-text pairs"; "task-agnostic image embeddings"

decision_rationale: CellDuality fine-tunes and steers an existing LLM for biological reasoning with SFT and self-supervised RLVR, so the contribution is an application wrapper rather than a new foundational model. The record does show autoregressive text generation, but not candidate-model foundation pretraining.
evidence_snippet: "output is a textual response y, generated autoregressively according to the policy"; "leveraging powerful teacher models"; "Supervised Fine-Tuning"; "RLVR"
